## Items Carried from B18 (Unchanged — Still OPEN)

### DW-B17-SYNC-01 — Copy ON/OFF sync (P2)

**Status**: DEFERRED to B20
**Target**: B20 (was B19 — B19 Lane 1 consumed by P0 COPIER-BUG-01)
**Files**: `CopyEngine.cs`, `TradeCopierPanel.cs`, `TradeCopierWindow.cs`

**Description**: Copy ON/OFF state shown in TradeCopierPanel (`_copyEnabled`) and
TradeCopierWindow (`_copyEnabled`) are completely independent. Toggling one surface does
NOT update the other. Same defect applies to Signal/Mirror mode.

**Fix design**:
1. Add `internal event Action<bool> CopyEnabledChanged` to `CopyEngine`.
2. Fire it at end of `SetEnabled(bool)`.
3. Both Panel and Window subscribe on Loaded, unsubscribe on Detach/Closed.
4. Handler updates `_copyEnabled` and button label/background via `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync`.
5. Same pattern for `SetCopyMode()` → `CopyModeChanged event Action<CopyMode>`.

### DW-B17-ACCOUNT-NAME-01 — Strip !Apex!Apex broker suffix (P2)

**Status**: DEFERRED to B20
**Target**: B20 (was B19 — B19 Lane 1 consumed by P0 COPIER-BUG-01)
**Files**: `TradeCopierWindow.cs`

**Description**: Account names display as `"PA-APEX-422136-02!Apex!Apex"` instead of
`"PA-APEX-422136-02"`. The `!Apex!Apex` suffix is the broker/connection identifier
appended to `Account.Name` by NT8 for real funded accounts. Strip at display layer only:
`acc.Name.Split('!')[0]`. Keep raw `acc.Name` for all engine dictionary keys to avoid
ATM template lookup mismatches.

## New Item Added This Block

### DW-B19-02 — `PopulateOrderMap` dedup guard reference equality (P2)

**Status**: OPEN — DEFERRED to B20+
**Priority**: P2
**Files**: `CopyEngine.cs`
**Line**: 659
**Discovered**: B19 Lane 1 audit (architecture plan Section 4)

**Description**: `PopulateOrderMap` contains a dedup guard at line 659:

```csharp
if (!bag.Any(b => b.FollowerAccount == followerAccount))   // reference equality
```

`b.FollowerAccount` is stored from a prior `e.Order.Account` reference. After a Rithmic
reconnect, both references may differ → dedup guard fails → duplicate `FollowerBinding`
entries accumulate → bracket sync fires multiple times for the same follower.

**Severity**: P2 (duplicate bracket syncs — not zero orders; different from the P0 bug).
**Fix identified**: Change to `b.FollowerAccount.Name == followerAccount.Name`.

**Deferred reasons**:
1. B19 scope was the P0 zero-orders bug (Director-specified single-line change).
2. No-Scope-Creep Protocol (AGENTS.md §11): one epic = one concern.
3. Director specified exactly one line change for B19 Lane 1.
4. Lane boundary: adding a second fix without Director approval violates protocol.

**Confirmed untouched**: Layer 3 verified line 659 is still original reference equality
(`b.FollowerAccount == followerAccount`) — not modified by B19.
